main.description: Stores an artifact, or one part of a large artifact, as a blob of a package, for a release that 'dev.zena-lang.host.publish' writes next. The caller must be a maintainer of the package. The body's type must be one an artifact has: 'application/vnd.ipld.car' for a source archive, 'application/wasm' for a component or core module, 'text/plain' for a component's WIT, or 'application/octet-stream' for a part; its parameters are dropped. A blob no release references is deleted after a while, as a PDS deletes unreferenced blobs.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The body's type is not one an artifact has.

errors.name: TooLarge
errors.description: The blob is larger than the host stores in one blob; upload it in parts.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The package's scope has used the storage the host allows.
